policy: A page counts as eligible content only if it passes the >=800 normalized-character heuristic AND is not listed below. Excluded: cover, disclaimer/front matter, table of contents, list of figures, reference lists.
reviewed_by: AI-assisted review (Claude Code) of the extracted text of every page; exclusion list accepted by the student

exclusions.reason: front matter: commercial-entity disclaimer, publication history, comments contact
front matter: About AI at NIST, acknowledgments, disclaimer

notes: NIST-AI-100-1 p16 (411 chars) is a figure whose extracted text is scrambled word order; already below threshold.
NIST-AI-100-1 p39 and NIST-AI-600-1 p50 hold real body text but are short (<800 chars), so they are not counted or indexed. Evidence on them cannot be retrieved.
